story_type: first-person parachute jump from a plane into a packed stadium
hook: Jumping out of a plane, into a packed NFL stadium.
narration: This is a parachute jump straight into a packed NFL stadium.
It began at the open door of the Army Golden Knights' plane, high over Maryland.
Then he stepped out, and the plane flew on without him.
Freefall, then the pull, and his canopy opened above him.
A square canopy flies like a wing, so the jumper steers with a toggle in each hand.
He spiraled down over the parking lots toward the stadium.
Thousands of fans were in the seats for the Salute to Service game.
outcome: He landed right on the field in the middle of the stadium.
title: Skydiving into a packed NFL stadium
description:
U.S. Army Parachute Team Golden Knights member Sgt. 1st Class Ben Hall films his parachute jump into Northwest Stadium in Landover, Maryland, on Nov. 8, 2026, during the Washington Commanders' Salute to Service game against the Los Angeles Rams.

Footage: U.S. Army video courtesy of Sgt. 1st Class Ben Hall, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/1029173
